display.purpose: The verdict word only; condensed to 78% width.

headline.purpose: Empty-state intro title and sign-in statement; condensed 84-88%.

block-title.purpose: Result block headings after the violet figure number.

figure.purpose: Headline metrics and approval-rate figures in tabular numerals.

body.purpose: Text and table cells; tabular figures throughout.

label.purpose: Field labels, chip and secondary button text.

caption.purpose: Captions, hints, metadata in Muted Slate.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused input or select. State signal, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every authored motion: publish, bar growth, stage tone change.

motion.name: publish
motion.value: 700ms ease-out, stagger 120/220/320/420ms, translateY(10px) + clip-path inset(0 0 40% 0) to none
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a decision publishes block by block.

motion.name: scan
motion.purpose: 1px running line under the active pipeline stage.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: 16px gutters, single-column fields, two-up metrics, no result grid.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Form and result stack; sign-in panel stacks.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes a top band with a five-column stage strip.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); width: 100%; max-width: 420px; height: 50px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 18px; background: var(--violet, #5B3FD0); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--violet-hover, #4C33B8); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #5B3FD0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet utility action such as Copy text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #17151C); border: 1px solid var(--field, #C9C7C0); border-radius: 3px; padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2, #3A3642); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #5B3FD0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sample Chip

components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #17151C); border: 1px solid var(--field, #C9C7C0); border-radius: 99px; padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--violet, #5B3FD0); background: var(--violet-tint, #ECE8FB); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #5B3FD0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: block; max-width: 260px; } .ds-label { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #3A3642); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-pre { position: absolute; left: 12px; color: var(--muted, #5F5B68); font-size: 15px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 42px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--field, #C9C7C0); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 12px 0 26px; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink, #17151C); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6775; font-style: italic; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #A9A6B2; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--violet, #5B3FD0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91,63,208,0.18); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Single-strip radio group; selected option fills Violet Ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; max-width: 360px; border: 1px solid var(--field, #C9C7C0); border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; min-height: 42px; } .ds-seg label { flex: 1; position: relative; display: flex; } .ds-seg label + label { border-left: 1px solid var(--field, #C9C7C0); } .ds-seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg span { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 6px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2, #3A3642); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-seg label:hover span { background: var(--violet-tint, #ECE8FB); } .ds-seg input:checked + span { background: var(--rail, #2A1F4D); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; } .ds-seg input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #5B3FD0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-pipe { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 24px; width: 264px; background: var(--rail, #2A1F4D); color: var(--rail-text, #E9E4FA); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pipe li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 4px; align-items: baseline; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rail-line, #4A3D78); font-size: 14px; transition: background-color 400ms; } .ds-pipe .n { color: var(--rail-muted, #A99BD8); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pipe small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--rail-muted, #A99BD8); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-pipe b { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pipe b.pass { color: var(--pass-on-rail, #7FD1A6); } .ds-pipe li.focus { background: var(--ground, #F4F4F2); color: var(--ink, #17151C); margin: 0 -24px 0 -12px; padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 24px; border-bottom-color: transparent; } .ds-pipe li.focus .n { color: var(--violet, #5B3FD0); } .ds-pipe li.focus small { color: var(--muted, #5F5B68); } .ds-pipe li.focus b.pass { color: var(--pass, #1F7A4D); }

components.css: .ds-block { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); max-width: 560px; color: var(--ink, #17151C); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-head { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #17151C); padding-top: 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; } .ds-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-head h3 span { color: var(--violet, #5B3FD0); margin-right: 10px; } .ds-head em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted, #5F5B68); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0,1fr) 56px; gap: 16px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, #DDDCD6); font-size: 14.5px; } .ds-row .ax { position: relative; height: 16px; display: block; } .ds-row .ax::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -10px; bottom: -10px; width: 1px; background: var(--ink, #17151C); } .ds-row .ax i { position: absolute; top: 2px; height: 12px; display: block; } .ds-row i.pos { left: 50%; background: var(--pass, #1F7A4D); } .ds-row i.neg { right: 50%; background: var(--fail, #C8321E); } .ds-row b { text-align: right; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row b.pos { color: var(--pass, #1F7A4D); } .ds-row b.neg { color: var(--fail, #C8321E); } .ds-cap { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted, #5F5B68); margin: 10px 0 0; }

components.css: .ds-verdict { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); max-width: 620px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-verdict .line { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px 36px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-verdict h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 96px; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 78%; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 78; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 0.86; color: var(--pass, #1F7A4D); } .ds-verdict p { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 6px; } .ds-verdict b { display: block; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink, #17151C); } .ds-verdict span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted, #5F5B68); } .ds-verdict .scale { margin-top: 22px; position: relative; height: 26px; } .ds-verdict .scale i { position: absolute; display: block; } .ds-verdict .tr { top: 8px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 6px; background: var(--hair, #DDDCD6); } .ds-verdict .fl { top: 8px; left: 0; height: 6px; background: var(--pass, #1F7A4D); } .ds-verdict .cut { top: 2px; left: 50%; height: 18px; width: 1px; background: var(--ink, #17151C); }

narrative.overview:
Every decision is published the way a central bank publishes an annual report: a numbered table of contents, ruled sections, captioned figures and tables, and numbers set in tabular figures so they can be audited down a column. The page is a document, not a dashboard. Structure comes from 2px ink rules and hairline rows on a cool off-white ground, never from boxed cards.

A violet-ink rail holds the brand and the five-stage pipeline index; its right-hand "page number" column fills with each stage's result after a run, and the stage that decided the outcome extends out of the rail onto the page ground. The working area splits into a paper-white form column and a result column that carries a faint eight-column grid. The verdict word is the one moment of display scale; everything around it is restrained, dense and captioned.

Density is reading density: 15px body, 12.5px captions, generous rule-to-rule spacing (44px between blocks) rather than generous padding inside boxes. Colour carries state only. The one authored motion is the release "publishing" block by block.
keyCharacteristics: Violet-ink rail plus one violet action colour on a cool off-white ground.
Single family (Archivo) using its width axis: condensed for display, normal for text.
Sections headed by a 2px ink rule; rows divided by 1px hairlines.
Figures and tables numbered inline in their titles ("Fig. 1", "Table 1", "Doc. 1") with a muted caption beneath.
Flat: no cards, no badges, no elevation shadows.
Green, vermilion and amber appear only as decision or rule state.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, vermilion and amber mean pass, fail and review. They never decorate, and nothing else is coloured those hues.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Release Violet marks what you can act on or follow (button, focus, link, figure number). Violet Ink is the shell. No third accent.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in tabular figures so columns align and can be audited.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy at the top end comes from condensing Archivo, not from adding a second family. Sentence case throughout; no uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Ruled-Not-Boxed Rule
rules.body: A section is a 2px ink rule followed by a heading, not a card. Containers do not get backgrounds, borders on all sides, or shadows. The decision letter is the single bordered surface, because it represents a separate document.

dos: Do head every section or block with a 2px ink rule (Release Ink) and divide rows with 1px Hairline.
Do number result figures and tables inline in the title ("Fig. 1", "Table 1", "Doc. 1") in Release Violet, and caption them in 12.5px Muted Slate.
Do set all numbers in tabular figures and right-align numeric columns.
Do reserve Pass Green, Vermilion and Ledger Amber for decision and rule state, using the on-rail variants on Violet Ink.
Do use the Archivo width axis for display hierarchy (verdict 78%, statements 84–88%).
Do keep the 3px radius on interactive controls and the single violet filled button per surface.
donts: Don't use cards, badges, or soft drop shadows; this world refuses the white-card fintech dashboard.
Don't introduce a second typeface or uppercase tracked labels.
Don't colour anything green, red or amber unless it reports a state.
Don't add a second accent hue beside Release Violet and Violet Ink.
Don't box a block with a full border or background; the decision letter is the only bordered surface.
